methods.description: Join each exact physical component ID to the retained original source GeoJSON feature and to the native Atlas target by stored source ID, original ID and parent metadata; report role-specific fit and missing facts.
methods.software: Python 3.12.14 standard library; exact byte/hash matching

methods.description: Read pinned Git blobs and retained source receipts; preserve exact selected records and calculate hashes/counts without GIS or geometry transformation.
methods.units: bytes, SHA-256 digests, feature and record counts

conclusions.text: All 13 candidate component identities join to seven named 2018 Alaska county/county-equivalent source subjects and current Atlas target records.
The administrative source is not fit as authority for a distinct ecological or physical-region target; the intended physical target is not recorded in retained references.
GSHHG relations support coarse source-relative land support only; feature observation dates, shoreline accuracy and repair authority remain unknown.
The retained simplified and Atlas-recorded non-simplified geometry variants do not have an established exact applicability or transformation for these candidates.

commands: Run the packet source extractor with the repository Python 3.12 runtime from the repository root; it verifies immutable input blobs and produces only source evidence.
Run scripts/evidence-quality.mjs against this manifest for byte and identity validation.
